patthana18.17:1.1: āsavasampayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi,
patthana18.17:2.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavavippayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.17:3.1: āsavasampayuttaṃ hetuñca āsavavippayuttaṃ hetuñca dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto na hetuṃ dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. hetuyā nava.
patthana18.17:4.1: āsavasampayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana18.17:5.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na āsavasampayutto na na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ. hetuyā cattāri.
